column12: Porous bioresorbable radiopaque embolic microspheres for drug delivery
column13: Methods, copolymer materials and devices are provided for embolic arterial interventions (embolization therapy or embolotherapy). The provided microbeads may further contain, or be coated with, therapeutic agents such as paclitaxel, for targeted delivery of the therapeutics. column12: SURFACE CONJUGATION TO POLY(AMINE-CO-ESTER) NANOPARTICLES FOR TARGETING TO CELLS AND TISSUES
column13: Nanoparticles useful for drug delivery are described. In one aspect, the nanoparticles contain poly(amine-co-ester)s or poly(amine-co-amide)s (PACE) modified with poly(ethylene glycol) (PACE-PEG), and can be optionally blended with a second PACE polymer optionally containing endgroup modifications. In another aspect, the nanoparticles contain a core containing a PACE polymer optionally containing endgroup modifications, and a polymeric surfactant non-covalently conjugated to the surface of the nanoparticles. The nanoparticles contain a peptide or protein targeting moiety that is covalently conjugated to the PACE-PEG polymer or to the surfactant on the surface of the nanoparticles via a linkage that contains a succinimide or substituted sulfone moiety, respectively. The nanoparticles provide as a versatile platform for the delivery of nucleic acids, such as mRNA.

column12: Bioreducible poly (beta-amino ester)s for siRNA delivery
column13: Degradable polymers were synthesized that self-assemble with nucleic acids, proteins, hydrophobic drugs, and other small molecules to form particles that are effective for delivery into a cell, tissue and/or organism either in vitro or in vivo. The presently disclosed polymers demonstrate differential cell-type specificity, an ability to promote endosomal escape to protect the cargos from degradation and enhance delivery to the cytoplasm, and/or bioreducibility, which enables triggered intracellular drug release to be tuned to promote optimal delivery to the target cell type. The presently disclosed materials may be used to treat a wide variety of conditions or diseases, such as cancer, cardiovascular diseases, infectious diseases, and ophthalmic diseases.

column12: INJECTABLE PROLONGED-RELEASE HYDROGEL FORMULATIONS OF TOLL-LIKE RECEPTOR AGONISTS FOR INTRATUMORAL INJECTION TO INCREASE IMMUNOTHERAPY RESPONSE
column13: Some aspects of the present disclosure are generally related to injectable compositions, for example, for intratumoral drug delivery. In some embodiments, the injectable composition comprises a polymer configured to undergo a solution-gel transition when heated from room temperature to at or around body temperature, allowing for the injection of the injectable composition as a liquid with subsequent gelation to retain the composition at the injection location. In some embodiments, the injectable compositions may be capable of encapsulating radio-opaque label and/or a hydrophobic immunoadjuvant (e.g., imiquimod) at a concentration of greater than or equal to 0.5 mg/mL. Accordingly, some aspects of the present disclosure are related to the radio-opaque label facilitating visualization of the injectable composition during injection and/or the retention of the injectable composition at the injection location, allowing for localized and extended-release of the immunoadjuvant. Still other aspects are generally directed to related methods, kits, or the like.

column12: LONG-ACTING SUSTAINED-RELEASE PREPARATION CONTAINING PRAMIPEXOLE AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: Disclosed is a long-acting sustained-release preparation pharmaceutical composition containing pramipexole, comprising a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of pramipexole and a pharmaceutical high polymer material. The preparation is selected from a microsphere, a sustained-release particle, and a subcutaneous implant. The pharmaceutically acceptable salt of pramipexole is selected from erucate, stearate, oleate, α-linolenate, heptadecanoate, pamoate, and palmitate. The high polymer material is selected from PLGA, PLA, mPEG-PLA, and PEG-PLA-PEG. The present invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations and solves the problems of short release period and poor release effect of pramipexole in the prior art.

column12: DENDRIMER COMPOSITIONS AND USE IN TREATMENT OF NEUROLOGICAL AND CNS DISORDERS
column13: A dendrimer formulation, such as a PAMAM dendrimer or a multiarm PEG polymeric formulation has been developed for systemic administration to the brain or central nervous system. In the preferred embodiment, the dendrimers are in the form of dendrimer nanoparticles comprising poly(amidoamine)(PAMAM) hydroxyl-terminated dendrimers covalently linked to at least one therapeutic, prophylactic or diagnostic agent for treatment of one or more symptoms of neurodegenerative, neurodevelopmental or neurological disorders such as Rett syndrome of autism spectrum disorders. D6 generation dendrimers provide significantly enhanced uptake into areas of brain injury, providing a means for diagnosis as well as drug delivery.

column13: The present invention relates to liposomes displaying cationic charges on their outer surface. The liposomes can be functionalized with ligands through electrostatic interactions with the positive charges to give exosome-like vectors. Both the micro-vesicles and the exosome-like vectors are intended to be used to deliver functional (active) agents to cells, in particular those of the skin, for both cosmetic and therapeutic treatments.

column12: Influenza virus vaccine as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to an influenza virus vaccine as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the influenza virus vaccine, M15-HA is adopted as a target antigen of the influenza mRNA vaccine, nucleic acid modified M15-HAmRNA is prepared, then lipid nanoparticles are used for wrapping, the influenza virus vaccine is prepared, the lipid nanoparticles comprise ionizable lipid, auxiliary phospholipid, cholesterol and PEG lipid, and the molar ratio of the ionizable lipid to the auxiliary phospholipid to the cholesterol to the PEG lipid is 50: (10-15): (38-40): (1.5-2.5). Compared with the prior art, the influenza vaccine provided by the invention has the advantages of high antigen expression, higher long-acting immune protection effect, higher particle size uniformity, higher encapsulation efficiency and better targeted delivery efficiency and tissue permeability.

column12: PROCESS FOR PREPARING LIPOSOME-ENCAPSULATED PEPTIDE P33

column12: Photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material and its composition, preparation method, use, product, and preparation kit
column13: This invention provides a preparation, composition, product, and application of a photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material. The preparation includes dissolving Component A including a photosensitive polymer derivative having o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers and Component B including a polymer derivative having amine or alkene (double group) or sulfhydryl group in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A and solution B, respectively; mixing the solution A and solution B homogeneously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; initiating photo-coupled synergistic crosslinking under an irradiation of a UV light to form the hydrogel. The irradiation causes the o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers to generate an aldehyde group/keto group or a nitroso group to initiate photo-coupled synergetic crosslinking. The photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel has applications in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing and as a carrier of cell, protein or drug.

column12: Polyethyleneimine derivative and application thereof as gene drug carrier
column13: The invention discloses a polyethyleneimine derivative and application thereof as a gene drug carrier. The polyethyleneimine derivative is obtained by connecting an iron chelating agent to a side chain of polyethyleneimine through an amido bond. Polyethyleneimine is used as a basic carrier material and is connected with an iron metabolism regulating drug through an amido bond to synthesize a polyethyleneimine derivative, then the polyethyleneimine derivative is combined with a nucleic acid drug through self-assembly to form a nanoparticle core, and the nanoparticle core is connected with a PEG terminal to form a final preparation. The invention provides a targeted epigenetic combined medication mode for the first time. Different from a traditional administration mode, different drugs respectively aim at tumor iron metabolism and RNA methylation, and the anti-tumor curative effect can be effectively enhanced.

column12: Exosome surface modification by using NHS-PEG-NHS and application of exosome surface modification in targeted drug delivery
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of exosome modification, and particularly relates to an exosome modification method for connecting a target protein to the surface of an exosome by utilizing NHS-PEG-NHS to achieve a targeting or treatment effect, and application of the exosome modification method in targeted central nervous system demyelination disease treatment. In particular to a technology for modifying an exosome to enable the exosome to have targeting property and a preparation method of the exosome. NHS-PEG-NHS is used as a connecting substance, and protein, polypeptide and substances with primary amine groups on the surface can be connected to the surface of an exosome membrane. The modified exosome can load drugs and can be accurately delivered to tissues expressing specific proteins or polypeptides through oral administration, so that the bioavailability and the treatment effect of the drugs are remarkably improved. Taking the NG2 antibody modified cow milk exosome as an example, the NG2 antibody is connected to the surface of the cow milk exosome to target the central demyelination focus area, so that the effective therapeutic dose of the drug in the central focus area is achieved through oral delivery.

column12: Acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticles adaptive to pancreatic cancer and preparation method of acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticles
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano drug loading, and particularly relates to an acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticle adaptive to pancreatic cancer and a preparation method of the acid-responsive drug delivery nanoparticle. According to the polyphenol polymer disclosed by the invention, a biodegradable polyethylene glycol (PEG) polyphenol polymer is used as a skeleton, and then a hydrophobic drug improved gemcitabine and leflunomide are entrapped by using a metal ion chelation effect to form nanoparticles. The nanoparticles can respond to a special environment in tumor cells to release improved gemcitabine and leflunomide, can induce cell ferroptosis by regulating and controlling pancreatic tumor cell mitochondrial metabolism, can induce mitochondrial exocytosis to realize deep drug accumulation, and can realize deep drug accumulation through multi-cell immune-metabolic network regulation and control in tumor focus tissues. The immunosuppression microenvironment is relieved, and pancreatic tumors are inhibited.

column13: Disclosed herein are biocompatible and biodegradable nanomaterials combined with molecules of interest and stem cells in a variety of stable and safe compositions. column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of polymer micelles, and discloses a folic acid modified pH/reduction dual-response selenium-containing mixed polymer cross-linked micelle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The selenium-containing mixed polymer cross-linked micelle takes polycaprolactone (PCL) and methacrylic acid N, N-diethylaminoethyl ester (DEAEMA) as a core, and other block structures comprise polyethylene glycol (PEG), polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether monomethacrylate (PEGMA), hydroxyethyl methylacrylate (PHEM), folic acid (FA) and selenium caprylic acid (SA). column12: Citric acid fentanyl coated PLGA-PEG nano-microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to citric acid fentanyl-coated PLGA-PEG nano microspheres and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, preparing a citric acid fentanyl citrate solution and a PLGA-PEG solution; step S2, dropwise adding the citric acid fentanyl solution into the PLGA-PEG solution, mixing, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification to obtain primary emulsion; s3, dropwise adding the primary emulsion into a PVA (Polyvinyl Alcohol) solution, mixing, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification to obtain multiple emulsion; and step S4, dropwise adding the multiple emulsion into water, stirring to volatilize the organic solvent, and performing centrifugal filtration to obtain the citric acid fentanyl coated PLGA-PEG nano-microspheres. The PLGA-PEG nano-carrier is adopted as a drug carrier to carry the citric acid fentanyl citrate, and compared with an existing oral administration citric acid fentanyl citrate preparation, slow release of the citric acid fentanyl citrate can be achieved.

column12: PEG lipids and uses thereof
column13: The present disclosure in part provides compounds (i.e., PEG lipids) which are useful in pharmaceutical compositions, cosmetic compositions, and drug delivery systems, e.g, for use in lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulations. The present disclosure also provides LNP formulations comprising PEG lipids described herein, and methods of using the same. For example, the LNPs provided herein are useful for the delivery of an agent (e.g, therapeutic agent) to a subject. The PEG lipids and LNPs provided herein, in certain embodiments, exhibit increased PEG shedding compared to existing PEG lipids and LNP formulations.

column12: OLIGONUCLEOTIDE PHARMACEUTICAL PREPARATION FOR USE IN THE TREATMENT OF LIVER CANCER, AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR AND USE THEREOF
column13: Disclosed in the present invention is an oligonucleotide pharmaceutical preparation for use in the treatment of liver cancer, and a preparation method therefor and the use thereof. The pharmaceutical preparation consists of an oligonucleotide drug, a carrier and a solvent, wherein the oligonucleotide drug is PHN02ME, the oligonucleotide drug PHN02ME has five cap modifications at each end of a full thio-sequence, and the carrier consists of a nucleoside phospholipid TPS or CPS, a cationic lipid CLDA and an auxiliary lipid DSPE-PEG. In the present invention, by means of adjusting the ratio in the preparation and optimizing the solvent of the preparation, a novel anti-liver cancer pharmaceutical preparation having a great clinical application potential is obtained. After low-dose and low-frequency intravenous administration to mice, the preparation significantly inhibits the growth of liver cancer in mice, and exhibits an ideal sustained-release/long-acting anti-cancer effect, with an efficacy superior to that of a CT102/DNCA/CLD/PEG preparation. The present invention establishes a foundation for the wide clinical application of anti-liver cancer antisense nucleic acid drugs, and also has wide application prospects in the field of gene therapy.

column12: Hypotonic gel-forming formulations with enhanced rheological properties
column13: Improved hypotonic gel carriers are described as solubilizers for drugs and as a means to provide sustained drug delivery to the eye. It has been found that the addition of small amounts of low molecular weight PEG in the hypotonic gel-forming composition enhances the viscosity of the solution at the ocular surface, prolongs the tear rupture time and improves ocular comfort. The medicine is dissolved at a relatively high concentration, so that the permeability of the medicine to body tissues is enhanced, and meanwhile, the distribution of the medicine on a larger surface area is further improved by the low-permeability gel carrier, so that absorption and sustained release are increased, side effects are reduced, and the acting duration is prolonged.

column12: Preparation method of ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle sustained release preparation
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle sustained release preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing PLGA-PEG-PLGA gel particles loaded with ginsenoside Rh4, then, carrying out liposome encapsulation on the gel particles, and then, carrying out high-pressure homogenization or ultrasonication, so as to form the ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticles. In the preparation of the PLGA-PEG-PLGA gel particles loaded with ginsenoside Rh4, a triblock copolymer PLGA-PEG-PLGA is used as a gel material, and toxic and harmful organic solvents such as diethyl ether, acetone, ethanol, trichloromethane and the like are not used at all, so that the safety of the process and the product is improved. The ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticles are good in stability, can effectively slow down the drug release speed and achieve the sustained release effect, have wide application prospects, and have reference significance for development of drug sustained release preparations.

column12: A METHOD FOR PREPARING MICROPARTICLES FOR DRUG DELIVERY
column13: Disclosed is a method for preparing microparticles for drug delivery. The method comprises providing a mold comprising multiple individual, open compartments arranged on a first surface of the mold. The open compartments are separated from each other by one or more edges. Each edge has a width of 5 µm or less. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a mold layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a first release characteristic at a first condition. The method comprises loading the compartments coated with the mold layer with a pharmaceutical composition comprising a drug substance. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a top layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a second release characteristic at the first condition for provision of closed microparticles in the multiple individual compartments. The method comprises separating the closed microparticles by cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges. By cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges discrete microparticles are provided.

column13: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of biomedical materials. Provided are a composite gel, and a preparation method and an application thereof. column12: Nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines and nano preparations, and particularly relates to a nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs. The nano motor is composed of a nano carrier, a ferroptosis drug and an ultrasonic enhancer. Polyethylene glycol (PEG) modified polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) nanoparticles are preferably selected as the nano-carrier, gambogic acid is preferably selected as the ferroptosis drug, and perfluorobromooctane is preferably selected as the ultrasonic enhancer. The nanomotor is prepared by a nanoprecipitation method or a microfluidic method. The materials are simple and easy to obtain, the preparation operation is simple and convenient, the prepared nano motor has excellent high intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) response performance, deep driving and efficient accumulation towards a focus part can be realized under the action of HIFU, and controllable release of a medicine at a tumor part is realized. Meanwhile, the nano motor can cooperate with HIFU to enhance the ferroptosis effect of tumor cells, activate the anti-tumor immune effect of the body and inhibit the growth and metastasis of tumors.

column12: 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britanin multi-effect nano preparation as well as preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britanin multi-effect nano preparation as well as a preparation method and application of the 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britanin multi-effect nano preparation. A nanocrystal of 1, 6-O, O-diacetyl britannolactone (OABL) is rapidly formed in water by utilizing a solvent exchange strategy, and a metal-polyphenol polymer shell layer formed by self-assembling tannic acid and iron ions is rapidly formed on the surface of the OABL nanocrystal based on the biological adhesion characteristic of polyphenol and a polyphenol-metal interface self-assembling process, so that the metal-polyphenol polymer shell layer is formed. The stability of the OABL nanocrystal is effectively improved; the preparation method comprises the following steps: assembling metal-polyphenol and OABL nanocrystals by using a nano coprecipitation method, and modifying polyethylene glycol phospholipid modified transferrin receptor specific peptide (DSPE-PEG-T7) with a brain-targeting delivery effect to the surface of a multi-effect nano preparation, so as to realize the preparation of the brain-targeting multi-effect nano preparation of OABL. The multi-effect nano preparation of OABL provided by the invention has multiple activities of resisting neuroinflammation, resisting oxidative stress and the like, is beneficial to realizing the purpose of drug combination, can effectively deliver OABL to the brain and remarkably improve the bioavailability of the brain, and can be used for preparing a multi-effect nano drug for treating Alzheimer's disease.

column12: COVALENT ANESTHETIC-POLYMER CONJUGATES FOR PROLONGED LOCAL ANESTHESIA
column13: To provide anesthetics covalently conjugated onto biodegradable and biocompatible hydrophilic polymers via hydrolyzable linkages which provide controlled release of local anesthetics in vivo in an effective amount for nerve blockade with reduced toxicity relative to the unconjugated anesthetic agent.SOLUTION: The rate of anesthetic release can be tuned by changing the hydrophilicity of the polymer. Exemplary formulations of poly(glycerol sebacate) (PGS), optionally including polyethylene glycol (PEG) polymers conjugated to tetrodotoxin (TTX) (PGS-PEG-TTX and PGS-TTX), and methods of use thereof are provided. Nerve blockade from PGS-PEG-TTX and PGS-TTX has been associated with minimal systemic toxicity and local toxicity to the muscle and the peripheral nerves. TDP-TTX conjugates homogeneously dispersed into PEG200 are also described. PEG200 has not only worked as a medium, but also worked as a chemical permeation enhancer (CPE) to enhance the effectiveness of TTX.SELECTED DRAWING: None

column12: Antithrombogenic coatings
column13: An exemplary medical device includes a vascular device, such as a catheter, and an anti-thrombogenic coating on a surface of the vascular device, such as a surface that may contact blood. The anti-thrombogenic coating comprises one or more peptides configured to interact with fibrinogen in the blood, such as a first type of peptide configured to bind to fibrinogen and a second type of peptide configured to inhibit conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin. The anti-thrombogenic coating further comprises a polymer, such as a hydrocolloid polymer, tunable polyethylene glycol (PEG), or other controlled release polymer, configured to control release of the one or more peptides and maintain a concentration of the peptides at a surface of the anti-thrombogenic coating above a minimum inhibitory concentration, thereby inhibiting thrombin formation on an intravascular medical device.

column12: Drug-coated balloon
column13: Described here are devices, systems, and methods for treating conditions or diseases of the nose, ear, or throat with an expandable device having a drug coating. The expandable devices may be delivered to a body cavity in a low-profile configuration and expanded to contact surrounding tissue. The expandable devices may deliver or release the drug coating to the tissue. Multiple expansions of a single device may be employed during treatment. Various coating excipients and manufacturing parameters for the expandable devices may also be adjusted to enhance or slow transfer of the drug coating and/or release of the drug to the target tissue site. The drug transferred to the tissue may act as an in situ depot that enables maintenance of a therapeutic level of locally delivered drug for a desired time period after removal of the expandable devices.

column13: The present invention relates to a nanoparticle conjugate for drug delivery comprising of a dendrimer of PAMAM and PEG; wherein the PEGylated PAMAM dendrimer is conjugated with B19 aptamer. column12: EXTENDED RELEASE DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR OCULAR DRUGS AND METHODS OF USE
column13: Described herein are therapeutic compositions and methods of use, for the delivery of various drug substances, in and around the eye, comprising: a drug substance, noncovalently interacting with one or more complexation agent particulates to form drug substance-complex particulates, admixed within a hydrophobic dispersal medium, that collectively forms a stable multiphasic colloidal suspension, that serves as an extended release drug delivery system for ocular drug delivery. Formulation of the drug substance in the multiphasic colloidal suspension can be administered in and around the eye to produce sustained release of therapeutic levels of drug substance within ocular tissues for one or more months without requiring retreatment.

column12: INTRAVITREAL MITOCHONDRIAL-TARGETED PEPTIDE PRODRUGS AND METHODS OF USE
column13: Described herein are therapeutic compositions for the treatment of mitochondrial disorders, and in particular mitochondrial disorders of the eye, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). In particular, described herein are prodrugs of mitochondrial targeted tetrapeptides that have a cleavable covalent bond (e.g., an ester bond) to a conjugation moiety, wherein the conjugation moiety of the prodrug noncovalently complexes with one or more complexation agents to form drug-complex particulates with a defined avidity, and one or more drug-complex particulates are added to and dispersed within a dispersal medium forming a multiphasic colloidal suspension that serves as an extended release drug delivery system for ocular drug delivery. This extended release drug delivery system may be injected or inserted into the eye (e.g., vitreous) to reverse and prevent mitochondrial dysfunction in the eye for one or more months without requiring retreatment.

column12: Sugar lipid molecule, drug delivery carrier, drug compound and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a sugar lipid molecule, a drug delivery carrier, a drug compound and application thereof, and relates to the field of biological medicine and material chemistry. The compound has a structure as shown in a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, deuterated substance or prodrug thereof. The saccharide lipid molecule of # imgabs0 can replace PEG (polyethylene glycol) lipid, and a novel and efficient LNP delivery system is constructed. After the sugar lipid molecule replaces PEG lipid and is added into a basic LNP system, an original liver-targeted LNP delivery system can be converted into a spleen-targeted LNP delivery system. According to the delivery system, the charge size and hydrophobicity can be regulated and controlled in a great range by changing the length of a carbohydrate chain and the variety and number of hydrophobic chain segments, and nucleic acid molecules can be efficiently delivered.

column12: Preparation method and application of supramolecular hydrogel for injection
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of supramolecular hydrogel for injection, which comprises the following steps: linking a cyclodextrin derivative and HA through a chemical bond to prepare CD-HA, and linking an AD carboxylic acid derivative and PEG through a chemical bond to prepare AD-PEG; the CD-HA, the AD-PEG and the CUR are subjected to non-covalent interaction and then are combined with anticoagulant and regeneration promoting drugs through a self-assembly strategy to prepare the supramolecular hydrogel for injection; according to the supramolecular hydrogel disclosed by the invention, accumulative release experiments find that medicines in the supramolecular hydrogel have the characteristic of graded slow release, and a mouse injury model of femoral head necrosis proves that the supramolecular hydrogel for injection can be used for effectively treating femoral head necrosis and osteoarthritis and promoting bone regeneration; a local drug delivery strategy contained in the supramolecular hydrogel for injection for treating femoral head necrosis and osteoarthritis and promoting bone regeneration aims at showing the slow release/controlled release capability and anti-inflammatory effect of the supramolecular hydrogel for injection on drugs; the supramolecular hydrogel for injection for treating femoral head necrosis and osteoarthritis and promoting bone regeneration can control inflammatory response of the femoral head part and accelerate bone regeneration to finally realize treatment of femoral head necrosis.

column12: Method for realizing active controlled release and slow release of bioactive molecules and drug application
column13: The invention discloses a method for realizing active controlled release and slow release of bioactive molecules and drug application. At present, many protein or polypeptide drugs have the problems of short half-life period, frequent administration, large fluctuation of blood concentration, poor safety and the like, and particularly, clinical application is limited due to remarkable toxic and side effects of direct administration of IL-2 and other drugs. In the prior art, polyethylene glycol is usually used for modifying a medicine to prolong the physiological half-life period of the medicine and reduce the immunogenicity and toxic and side effects of the medicine, but the biological activity of the medicine modified by PEG is obviously reduced, and the effective release and bioavailability of the activity of the medicine in vivo are not ideal. According to the invention, a PEG modifier with a specific structure is screened through various experimental designs and repeated verification, and the PEG modifier can be widely used for active controlled release and slow release of various bioactive molecules. Particularly, the PEG modifier with the specific type and structure reacts with IL-2 to form a conjugate, under certain in-vitro conditions or in-vivo physiological conditions, the effects that PEG gradually falls off from the conjugate and the activity of IL-2 is gradually released are achieved, a certain effective blood concentration of bioactive molecules can be maintained, and the bioavailability is improved. The active sustained release and controlled release of the drug in vivo and in vitro are realized, the dynamic balance of better drug bioavailability and safety can be achieved, and the drug delivery frequency is reduced, the drug bioavailability is improved, the patient compliance is better, the safety is better, and other clinical application prospects are achieved.

According to the present invention, two amphiphilic auxiliary materials, phospholipid and PEG, are selected. The phospholipid on an outer layer prevents the coating from being washed away by blood in the balloon delivery process, achieves drug retention at the target site by being intermiscible with the cell membrane, and improves biocompatibility. The hydrophilic excipient PEG enables the surface of the drug coating and the surface of the balloon to form an easy-to-strip state and thus allows the drug coating to be separated from the surface of the balloon, so that the balance between bonding and stripping is realized. An mPEG-PLGA block copolymer with a specific molecular weight is creatively added in the present invention to realize controllable release of the drug, and the drug coating with an adjustable drug release rate is obtained by adjusting the molecular weight of the mPEG, so that the application range of the drug coating is expanded.

column12: Photothermal composite hydrogel with adjustable slow release performance and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a photo-thermal composite hydrogel with adjustable slow release performance and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: 1, dissolving PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) and PLGA-PEG (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)-PEG-PLGA, and performing ultrasonic emulsification to obtain a primary emulsion; 2, adding the primary emulsion into a PVA solution, stirring, centrifuging, washing with water, re-dispersing to obtain a secondary emulsion, and freeze-drying to obtain polymer microspheres; and 3, adding the polymer microspheres and the gold nanoparticles into the PLGA-PEG-PLGA solution, and carrying out gelation, so as to obtain the photo-thermal composite hydrogel. Polymer microspheres with controlled release performance are prepared from PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) and PLGA-PEG (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)-PEG-PLGA through a double-emulsification method, and then the polymer microspheres and gold nanoparticles are loaded into the thermo-sensitive hydrogel together, so that the photo-thermal composite hydrogel capable of simultaneously realizing regulation and control of the drug delivery rate and the photo-thermal conversion temperature is prepared, synergistic treatment of drug treatment and photo-thermal treatment is favorably realized, and the photo-thermal composite hydrogel has a good application prospect. The conjugate generates no fluorescent signal and reactive oxygen in normal tissues or during the circulation in the blood by quenching a fluorescent signal and reactive oxygen generation ability of the photosensitizer. After the conjugate is selectively absorbed into target cells, a linker is degraded in cells to increase the distance between tryptophan included in the peptide and the photosensitizer, and the quenching action is terminated to generate a strong fluorescence signal and induce active generation of reactive oxygen. column13: An apparatus, composition, and method for generating odor on demand. The apparatus includes a dispersing mechanism with a plurality of blister pockets each including a releasable aroma. column12: PEGYLATED LIPID AND LIPOSOME MODIFIED THEREBY, AND PHARMACEUTICAL COMPOSITION COMPRISING LIPOSOME AND PREPARATION AND USE THEREOF
column13: The present invention provides a novel PEGylated lipid and preparation methods thereof, a cationic liposome containing the PEGylated lipid, a pharmaceutical composition containing the liposome, a formulation and application thereof, belonging to the field of drug delivery. The PEGylated lipid of the present invention can be used for modifying a liposome, and it can also be further modified and coupled with a targeting group, and then used for modifying a liposome to obtain a liposome with the targeting group. Due to the presence of a long-chain PEG and the targeting group on the PEGylated lipid, the modified liposome can not only effectively avoid being removed by the reticuloendothelial system in a human body, but also realize a targeting function. Therefore, when the liposome modified by the PEGylated lipid delivers an active drug to cells or a patient, especially when delivering a nucleic acid drug and anti-tumor drug, the liposome can not only realize long circulation in vivo and improve the transport efficiency of drug, but also has a targeting function, so that the therapeutic effect of a drug is improved under a synergistic effect.

column12: Metal-organic framework composite hydrogel bone repair material with controllable growth factor co-delivery and preparation method of metal-organic framework composite hydrogel bone repair material

column12: Double-crosslinking hydrogel capable of controllably releasing medicine as well as preparation method and application of double-crosslinking hydrogel
column13: The invention provides bi-crosslinking hydrogel capable of controllably releasing drugs. A preparation method of the bi-crosslinking hydrogel comprises the following steps: S1, adding a sodium hyaluronate aqueous solution into ultrapure water, magnetically stirring, adding HOBT and EDC, reacting at room temperature, adding adipic dihydrazide ADH to adjust the pH value, continuously reacting to obtain a reaction solution I, dialyzing, and freeze-drying to obtain HA-CDH; s2, adding HA-CDH into ultrapure water, and completely dissolving HA-CDH to obtain a hydrogel precursor A; s3, adding the DF-PEG-DF into ultrapure water, and completely dissolving to obtain a hydrogel precursor B; s4, adding tetrachloroauric acid tetrahydrate into ultrapure water, and completely dissolving to obtain a hydrogel precursor C; and S5, uniformly mixing the hydrogel precursor A, the hydrogel precursor B and the hydrogel precursor to obtain the double-crosslinking hydrogel capable of controlling the drug release. The prepared bi-crosslinking hydrogel has injectability and good anti-inflammatory performance, photo-thermal performance, mechanical performance, stability and safety, the slow release effect can be achieved after medicine carrying, and the medicine release rate can be regulated and controlled.

column12: Pegylated lipid, liposome modified by pegylated lipid, pharmaceutical composition containing liposome, and preparation and application of pharmaceutical composition
column13: The invention discloses a pegylated lipid and a preparation method thereof, a liposome containing the pegylated lipid, a pharmaceutical composition containing the liposome as well as a preparation and application of the pharmaceutical composition, and belongs to the field of drug delivery. The pegylated lipid provided by the invention can be used for modifying the liposome, and can also be further modified and coupled with the targeting group and then used for modifying the liposome to obtain the liposome with the targeting group. Due to the existence of the long-chain PEG and the targeting group on the pegylated lipid, the modified liposome not only can effectively avoid the removal of the liposome by the reticuloendothelial system in the human body, but also can realize the targeting function. Therefore, when the pegylated lipid modified lipidosome delivers active drugs to cells or patients, especially nucleic acid drugs and anti-tumor drugs, the lipidosome not only can realize long circulation and improve the drug transport rate in vivo, but also has a targeting function, and improves the treatment effect of the drugs under the synergistic effect.

column12: NANOMATERIAL-STEM CELL COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF USE
column13: Disclosed herein are biocompatible and biodegradable nanomaterials combined with molecules of interest and stem cells in a variety of stable and safe compositions. The nanomaterials comprise poly(ethylene glycol)-oligo(ethylene sulfide) (PEG-OES) amphiphilic block-copolymers that self-assemble in supramolecular aggregates of fibrillar shape. The fibrillar architecture of the assemblies allows the easy, fast and not harmful internalization into stem cells, including the preferred umbilical cord derived mesenchymal stem cells (UC-MSC). The OES core enables loading of hydrophobic molecules, such as imaging agents and drugs, which are carried by the nFIB into the stem cells for a final product that comprises a composition of MSC, nFIB and therapeutic molecule (e.g., MSC-nFIB-Rapamycin). The technology can be utilized to enhance the immunoregulatory potency of MSC via intracellular nanomaterial delivery of immunosuppressive drugs, and to obtain active site-targeting and localized delivery of drug-loaded nanofibrils by exploiting the MSC homing ability.

column13: A targeting delivery system loaded with whole-cell components, which relates to the technical field of immunotherapy. column12: Preparation method of flexible dynamic bioactive antifouling interface and application of flexible dynamic bioactive antifouling interface in separation of heterogeneous circulating tumor cells
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible dynamic bioactive antifouling interface and application of the flexible dynamic bioactive antifouling interface in separation of heterogeneous circulating tumor cells. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a TiO2 nanotube; (2) preparing a TiO2 nanotube/silk fibroin composite membrane; and (3) preparing the flexible dynamic bioactive antifouling interface. According to the invention, a novel flexible dynamic biological interface capable of specifically capturing heterogeneous tumor cells and realizing controllable release of the cells is prepared by constructing a flexible substrate material and modifying the surface to graft two sections of bioactive peptides; the problems of cell damage caused by the rigidity problem of a substrate material, low specific capture efficiency caused by tumor cell heterogeneity and the like are solved to a certain extent. Meanwhile, benefited from the combined action of a non-bioactive PEG antifouling chain and bovine serum albumin on the bioactive peptide, the interface can effectively inhibit the non-specific adhesion of blood protein and cells.

column12: Multifunctional iron-based photo-thermal controlled-release agarose hydrogel system
column13: The invention discloses a multifunctional iron-based photo-thermal controlled release agarose hydrogel system. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a ferrous sulfide two-dimensional nanosheet by taking ammonium ferrous sulfate and thioacetamide as raw materials; the preparation method comprises the following steps: modifying a ferrous sulfide two-dimensional nanosheet by using methoxy polyethylene glycol mercaptan to obtain FeS-PEG; dissolving agarose in a TAE buffer solution, heating in a water bath until the agarose is completely dissolved, and cooling to a liquid state to obtain an agarose solution; sequentially mixing an agarose solution, a calcium ascorbate aqueous solution and a FeS-PEG aqueous solution, and placing at room temperature to form gel, so as to obtain the multifunctional iron-based photo-thermal controlled-release agarose hydrogel system. According to the hydrogel system disclosed by the invention, the hydrogel and the iron-based nanosheets can be degraded through controlled release of calcium ascorbate, and controllable degradation of a drug carrier and a photosensitizer is realized at the same time, so that the clinical curative effect of endometriosis treatment is expected to be remarkably improved.

column12: Injectable and biodegradable polymer formulations for controlled release of bioactive agents
column13: The present disclosure is directed to injectable formulations that include biodegradable polymers based on trimethylene carbonate (TMC) with mole fractions of polylactic acid (PLA) and/or polyglycolic acid (PGA) that are used to deliver a bioactive agent to a targeted site. Excipients such as polyethylene glycol (PEG) may be added to the formulations to reduce the injection force and/or to modulate the release of the bioactive agent. Suitable biodegradable polymers for use in the injectable formulations include D,L-PLA:TMC, D-PLA:TMC, L-PLA:TMC, TMC:PLA:PGA and variations thereof. Additionally, copolymers of TMC and PLA and terpolymers of TMC:PLA:PGA may be formed into nanoparticles and delivered to the target site with an injectable crosslinkable polyethylene glycol system. In at least one embodiment, the injectable formulations are used to treat ocular diseases.

column12: Preparation method and application of composite hydrogel for treating osteomyelitis

column12: GMP/GP intelligent hydrogel periosteum with near-infrared and enzyme dual response functions and preparation method of GMP/GP intelligent hydrogel periosteum

column12: Antidiabetic pharmaceutical compositions and preparation method thereof
column13: An oral dosage form of an antidiabetic pharmaceutical composition comprises a core portion, an outer portion, and a controlled membrane film sandwiched therebetween. The core and outer portions respectively comprise a first antidiabetic agent and a second antidiabetic agent, such as metformin HCl and sitagliptin phosphate, each at a therapeutically effective amount. column12: Photocatalysis-mediated nitric oxide release polymer as well as preparation method and anti-biofilm application thereof
column13: The invention provides a photocatalysis-mediated nitric oxide release polymer, and a preparation method and an anti-biofilm application thereof. The photocatalysis-mediated nitric oxide release polymer is obtained by polymerizing a PEG (Polyethylene Glycol) macromolecular chain transfer agent, a nitric oxide donor molecular monomer and a phthalocyanine photosensitizer molecular monomer, wherein the structural formula of the nitric oxide donor molecular monomer is as shown in a formula A. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the photocatalysis-mediated nitric oxide release polymer. The polymer is prepared from a nitric oxide donor molecular monomer and a phthalocyanine photosensitizer molecular monomer in a reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer polymerization manner, so that the prepared polymer can realize the controllable release of NO in a long wavelength range of 600-800nm under the illumination intensity of 30-50mW/cm < 2 >. Results show that the polymer has a good killing effect on gram-positive bacteria and gram-negative bacteria, and can effectively disperse biological membranes formed by common germs.

column12: Preparation method and application of GSH response type nano motor
column13: The invention designs a preparation method of a GSH response type nano motor, the nano motor is vesicular, the particle size is 100-500 nanometers, the preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, using disulfide bond as a linking agent to bond polyethylene glycol (PEG) and polystyrene (PS) to synthesize a block polymer PEG-SS-PS; s2, taking the PEG-SS-PS, and dissolving the PEG-SS-PS in an organic solvent THF/dioxane; s3, adding an inducer to induce mutual crosslinking of PS to form a vesicle shape; and S4, removing the organic solvent and the inducer through dialysis to obtain the GSH response type nano motor. According to the designed GSH response type nano motor, the toxicity of the platinum nano particles and adriamycin is relieved through response GSH splitting decomposition, meanwhile, the transmission range of adriamycin can be widened through movement through near-infrared light treatment, ROS generated by the platinum nano particles cooperates with adriamycin to treat osteosarcoma, the defect of passive transportation of an existing drug transmission system is overcome, and the drug delivery system has good application prospects. The material adopted by the invention is simple in design, can be used for drug delivery, and provides a research basis for osteosarcoma treatment.

column12: SPECIFIC CONJUGATION FOR AN ANTIBODY-DRUG CONJUGATE
column13: Provided herein is a process for preparing a homogeneous conjugate of an antibody or antibody-like protein via linkage of cysteine sites between heavy-light chains in the IgG antibody or antibody-like protein. Provided herein also are methods of making the conjugates in a specific manner comprising either generation of specific thiols of an antibody or antibody-like protein agent, followed by reaction with drug/linker complexes, or generation of specific thiols of an antibody or antibody-like protein agent and conjugation of a synthetic linker-drug assembly with the thiols simultaneously in one pot reaction, to provide conjugates with over 75%, in most cases more than 80%of payloads linked at the specific cysteine sites between heavy-light chains of the IgG antibody or antibody-like protein. It also relates to methods of using the homogeneous conjugate in targeted prophylaxis or treatment of cancer, infection and immunological disorders.

column12: Recombinant urate oxidase polyethylene glycol prodrug conjugate and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to a recombinant urate oxidase polyethylene glycol prodrug conjugate and a preparation method thereof. The prodrug conjugate is a prodrug conjugate PEG-L-UOX of recombinant urate oxidase (rUOX) and polyethylene glycol (PEG), the PEG is connected with the recombinant urate oxidase (rUOX) through a temporary linker which can be hydrolyzed by itself and can be automatically split, and each recombinant urate oxidase molecule is averagely combined with 8-10 polyethylene glycol molecules. PEG of the prodrug conjugate (PEG-L-UOX) can be degraded and separated from a conjugate structure, so that slow release and controlled release of recombinant urate oxidase can be realized, the half-life period of a drug is prolonged, the administration frequency is reduced, and the bioavailability of the drug and the compliance of a patient are greatly improved; meanwhile, animal experiments show that compared with traditional PEG-modified urate oxidase (PEG-UOX), the derivative provided by the invention can reduce the generation probability of cell vacuoles, can possibly reduce the potential risk of causing cardiovascular diseases, and is beneficial to subsequent drug effect optimization and pharmacological research.

column12: Non-invasive ocular drug delivery insert technology
column13: Non-invasive Ocular Drug Delivery Insert Technology. The invention concerns an ocular insert which is a new biocompatible polymer-based controlled drug delivery system (CDDS) applicable to a variety of drugs and other compounds for the treatment of different ocular pathologies. This ocular insert allows releasing of at least one drug under suitable concentration levels during suitable periods of time. The device may be inserted in the lower or upper fornix conjunctiva, in a non-invasive way, meaning that the patient will be able to place the device himself, without intervention of medical specialized staff. The insert of the invention will release the drug in such a controlled rate that will allow the drug release up to 300 days by either a “Fickian” or a linear profile according to the intend purpose or pathology. The insert can be prepared with different shapes (spherical or spherical dome) and/or architectures (monolithic/layered either with or without a drug core) allowing the incorporation of at least one drug which can be released at different rates. The size, shape and design of the insert is adjusted in order to tune the drug(s) delivery profile(s) and to inhibit the risk of displacement or expulsion.

column13: A novel embodiment of a drive mechanism for use in a pump, for example, of the type that would be used in a wearable drug delivery system, comprises, a cylindrically-shaped slider element configured with a channel on a circumferential surface thereof defining one or more zig-zag-shaped tracks therethrough. One or more pegs are engaged within the tracks, such that a back and forth longitudinal motion of the slider element along a radial axis of the cylinder causes movement of the pegs along one of the tracks through the channel, thus providing a movement of the pegs around the circumference of the cylinder which imparts a rotational motion to a header element disposed co-axially with the slider. column12: Preparation method of oil-phase-free emulsion gel
column13: The invention belongs to the field of emulsion gels, and provides a preparation method of an oil-phase-free emulsion gel, which comprises the following steps: adding CMCs (Carboxymethyl Cellulose) into a PEG (Polyethylene Glycol) solution to obtain a PEG/CMCs mixed solution; dex-CHO is added into the Dex solution, and a Dex/Dex-CHO mixed solution is obtained; and carrying out vortex mixing on the PEG/CMCs mixed solution and the Dex/Dex-CHO mixed solution or Dex-CHO solution, and carrying out a reaction to obtain the PEG/CMCs/Dex-CHO composite material. column12: TWO-DIMENSIONAL (2D) NANOCOMPOSITE, PREPARATION METHOD, AND USE THEREOF
column13: A nanocomposite includes an oxygen vacancy-containing BiOX particle and a coating, where the coating is a biocompatible material. Under near-infrared (NIR) irradiation, the nanocomposite has a photothermal conversion efficiency of greater than or equal to 10%. Under NIR irradiation, the nanocomposite degrades 1,3-diphenylisobenzofuran (DPBF) at a rate of higher than or equal to 0.1 mmol/h. BiOX may be BiOF, BiOCl, BiOBr, BiOI, or BiOAt. A preparation method and a use of the nanocomposite are further provided. The nanocomposite is a bismuth oxyhalide nanomaterial with different numbers of oxygen vacancies and can be used for the photothermal therapy (PTT) of a tumor and for the integrated tumor diagnosis and treatment. The nanocomposite leads to an excellent therapeutic effect under the guidance of multi-modality imaging, and has excellent computed tomography (CT) imaging and photoacoustic imaging (PAI) performance.

column12: Medicine for combined immunization, temperature-sensitive gel composition, chemotactic factor particles and application of chemotactic factor particles
column13: The invention discloses a medicine for combined immunization, a temperature-sensitive gel composition, chemotactic factor particles and application thereof, a mixed solution of an injectable temperature-sensitive polymer PLGA-PEG-PLGA, the chemotactic factor particles and an immune checkpoint inhibitor PD-1 monoclonal antibody is used, temperature-sensitive hydrogel is formed beside a solid tumor at the body temperature, a chemotactic factor and aPD1 are controllably released for a long time, and the combined immunization is achieved. The targeting of adoptive T cells to solid tumors and the resistance to immunosuppression in a tumor microenvironment are enhanced. The immunoregulation temperature-sensitive gel and the tumor penetrating peptide iRGD are combined to enhance infiltration of adoptive T cells to solid tumors, so that the solid tumors are efficiently treated. The chemotactic factor particles are prepared from a chemotactic factor modified by distearoyl phosphoethanolamine-polyethylene glycol-N-hydroxysuccinimide and an albumin carrier.

column12: EDB-FN AS BIOMARKER OF CANCER AND/OR BRAIN DISEASE AND NANODRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM TARGETING SAME

The drug delivery system targets extra-domain B of fibronectin (EDB-FN), which is overexpressed in a brain tumor, and can pass through the blood-brain barrier (BBB) or the blood-brain tumor barrier (BBTB) to deliver a drug specifically to the brain tumor cells. In addition, the present invention can provide a pharmaceutical composition for diagnosing or treating a brain tumor, comprising the drug-loaded drug delivery system as an active ingredient. The composition can be accumulated inside the brain tumor and incorporated into the tumor cells to specifically inhibit tumor growth, and thus can be efficiently utilized for diagnosing or treating a brain tumor.

column12: Biodegradable hydrogel composition for delivery of multiple drugs as well as preparation method and application of biodegradable hydrogel composition
column13: The invention belongs to the field of drug delivery carriers, and particularly relates to a biodegradable hydrogel composition for delivery of various drugs as well as a preparation method and application of the biodegradable hydrogel composition. column12: Pegylated lipid, liposome modified by pegylated lipid, pharmaceutical composition containing liposome, and preparation and application of pharmaceutical composition
column13: The invention discloses a pegylated lipid and a preparation method thereof, a liposome containing the pegylated lipid, a pharmaceutical composition containing the liposome as well as a preparation and application of the pharmaceutical composition, and belongs to the field of drug delivery. The pegylated lipid provided by the invention can be used for modifying the liposome, and can also be further modified and coupled with the targeting group and then used for modifying the liposome to obtain the liposome with the targeting group. Due to the existence of the long-chain PEG and the targeting group on the pegylated lipid, the modified liposome not only can effectively avoid the removal of the liposome by the reticuloendothelial system in the human body, but also can realize the targeting function. Therefore, when the pegylated lipid modified lipidosome delivers active drugs to cells or patients, especially nucleic acid drugs and anti-tumor drugs, the lipidosome not only can realize long circulation and improve the drug transport rate in vivo, but also has a targeting function, and improves the treatment effect of the drugs under the synergistic effect.

column12: AMPHIPHILIC OLIGOMERS AND SELF-ASSEMBLING HYDROGELS FORMED THEREFROM
column13: Amphiphilic oligomers are provided that yield self-assembled, phase-separated hydrogels suitable for sustained release drug delivery. The oligomers are of formula (D-C-A-C)n-B or (D-C-B-C)n-A, where A represents a hydrophilic segment such as polyethylene glycol, B is a degradable hydrophobic segment such as polycaprolactone, C is a linking group comprising a urethane or urea linkage, D is a terminal catechol adhesive group capable of cross- linking, and n is 2 or 3. The oligomers are prepared by (i) reacting either one of a hydrophilic polyol or a hydrophobic polyol with a diisocyanate compound; (ii) reacting the product of step (i) with the other of the hydrophilic polyol and hydrophobic polyol; and (iii) reacting the product of step (ii) with a catechol derivative to form the terminal adhesive groups.

column12: Application of lanthanum-doped zinc oxide quantum dot as carrier in preparation of antitumor active substance
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medical material application, and particularly relates to application of lanthanum-doped zinc oxide quantum dots as a carrier in preparation of antitumor active substances. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and reacting a lanthanum-containing zinc acetate ethanol solution and a strong alkali ethanol solution in an ice bath to obtain a lanthanum-doped ZnO quantum dot ethanol solution, adding n-hexane for extraction, performing centrifugal separation, removing supernate, and performing vacuum drying to obtain the lanthanum-doped ZnO quantum dots. And modifying by using polyethylene glycol and hyaluronic acid to obtain the HA-PEG-La-ZnO composite nano drug loading platform. The method disclosed by the invention is simple, low in cost and favorable for realizing large-scale production; the lanthanum-doped ZnO quantum dot has relatively high fluorescence intensity and fluorescence quantum yield, and can be used in the fields of biological imaging, drug carriers and the like.

column12: Double-drug nano diamond drug capable of releasing drug in pH response as well as preparation method and application of double-drug nano diamond drug
column13: The invention provides a pH-responsive drug release double-drug nano-diamond drug as well as a preparation method and application of the pH-responsive drug release double-drug nano-diamond drug. The preparation method of the drug comprises the following steps: firstly, enabling all-trans retinaldehyde (ATR), namely a precursor of all-trans retinoic acid, and cystamine dihydrochloride to form cystaminated all-trans retinaldehyde (ASS) through an imine bond, then further enabling the cystaminated all-trans retinaldehyde (ASS) and PEG modified nano diamond (ND) to generate an ND-PEG-ASS (NPA) nano drug, and physically adsorbing doxorubicin (DOX) by the nano drug to form the double-drug nano drug ND-PEG-ASS (at) DOX (NPA (at) D). In-vitro drug release experiments show that the system is a drug delivery system sensitive to pH. A cytotoxicity result shows that the NPA at D nano-drug can be used for inhibiting the growth of the DOX-sensitive MCF-7 cells and the growth of the DOX-resistant MCF-7/ADR cells. More importantly, compared with NP (at) D, the NPA (at) D nano-drug more effectively inhibits cell viability and migration in a synergistic manner. In addition, the NPA at D nano-drug can prevent P-gp glycoprotein over-expressed on a drug-resistant tumor cell membrane from being pumped out of the chemotherapeutic drug, so that the drug resistance of drug-resistant MCF-7/ADR cells is reversed.

column12: SPECIFIC CONJUGATION OF AN ANTIBODY
column13: Provided herein is a process for preparing a homogeneous conjugate of an antibody or antibody-like protein via linkage of cysteine sites between heavy-light chains in the IgG antibody or antibody-like protein. It also relates to methods of making the conjugates in a specific manner comprising either generation of specific thiols of an antibody or antibody-like protein agent, followed by reaction with drug/linker complexes, or generation of specific thiols of an antibody or antibody-like protein agent and conjugation of a synthetic linker-drug assembly with the thiols simultaneously in one pot reaction, to provide conjugates with over 75%, in most cases more than 80% of payloads linked at the specific cysteine sites between heavy-light chains of the IgG antibody or antibody-like protein. It also relates to methods of using the homogeneous conjugate in targeted prophylaxis or treatment of cancer, infection and immunological disorders.

column12: INTRAVITREAL MITOCHONDRIAL-TARGETED PEPTIDE PRODRUGS AND METHODS OF USE
column13: Described herein are therapeutic compositions for the treatment of mitochondrial disorders, and in particular mitochondrial disorders of the eye, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). In particular, described herein are prodrugs of mitochondrial targeted tetrapeptides that have a cleavable covalent bond (e.g., an ester bond) to a conjugation moiety, wherein the conjugation moiety of the prodrug noncovalently complexes with one or more complexation agents to form drug-complex particulates with a defined avidity, and one or more drug-complex particulates are added to and dispersed within a dispersal medium forming a multiphasic colloidal suspension that serves as an extended release drug delivery system for ocular drug delivery. This extended release drug delivery system may be injected or inserted into the eye (e.g., vitreous) to reverse and prevent mitochondrial dysfunction in the eye for one or more months without requiring retreatment.

column12: Injectable hydrogel system with immune microenvironment regulation and control function
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and relates to a hydrogel system with a temperature-sensitive injectable function and an immune microenvironment regulation function. According to the invention, the double-component PEG-PLGA-PEG injectable hydrogel is used as a drug carrier, and the plerixafor-zinc chelate is selected and synthesized to realize slow release of the micromolecular hydrophilic drug plerixafor; the nanoparticles prepared based on an electrostatic adsorption technology are selected to realize slow release of biomacromolecule CpG oligodeoxynucleotide in the hydrogel and increase of antigen presentation efficiency. The co-delivery system has the function of sol-gel transition at the body temperature (higher than 30 DEG C), and can be used for in-situ direct filling of a clinical postoperative resection cavity. And co-loading and slow release of the loaded micromolecular drug plerixafor and the macromolecular drug are realized, the tumor postoperative immune microenvironment is cooperatively regulated and controlled, the killing effect of an immune system on residual tumor cells is enhanced, and postoperative recurrence of glioblastoma is inhibited.

column12: Preparation method and application of targeted polyethylene glycol drug carrier
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine carriers, and particularly relates to a targeted PEG (polyethylene glycol) medicine carrier as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the method, the template removal and PEG cross-linking processes are synchronously realized, additional steps for removing the template are not needed, the preparation method is simple, convenient and rapid, the operability is high, and large-scale preparation can be realized. The carrier prepared by the invention is completely cross-linked by PEG molecules, the problem of low PEG modification density in the existing PEGylated drug carrier is effectively avoided, and the phenomenon of accelerating blood clearance can be effectively inhibited, so that the efficient delivery of the drug is realized. The introduction of the targeting molecules can realize the specific interaction between the drug carrier and tumor cells and the specific enrichment of tumors in the body, thereby improving the efficiency of drug delivery.

column12: Preparation method of drug sustained release microspheres
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of drug sustained release microspheres. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing amorphous nano-hydroxyapatite; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing nHAP in an inorganic salt solution to serve as an internal water phase, dissolving PLGA and PDLLA-PEG-PDLLA in ethyl acetate to serve as an oil phase, emulsifying to prepare a W/O emulsion, and emulsifying the W/O emulsion and a polyvinyl alcohol solution to obtain a W/O/W emulsion; the W/O/W emulsion is subjected to etching and freeze drying, and nHAP-PLGA porous microspheres are obtained; the nHAP-PLGA porous microspheres and dopamine are dissolved in a buffer solution, freeze drying is carried out, and PDA modified nHAP-PLGA porous microspheres are obtained; the PDA modified nHAP-PLGA porous microspheres are dispersed in a phosphate buffer solution, a recombinant human type II tumor necrosis factor receptor antibody fusion protein (rhTNFR: Fc) solution is applied, and the rhTNFR: Fc-PLGA injectable drug sustained release microspheres are obtained after freeze drying. According to the invention, the structural similarity of the phosphatidyl prodrug and the traditional phospholipid is creatively utilized to prepare the liposome-like nano preparation which does not need to be added with phospholipid but also has a bilayer structure, and the preparation can respond to hydrolysis triggered by phospholipase D highly expressed at a tumor site and can be used for preparing the liposome-like nano preparation. The purpose of specifically releasing two synergistic chemotherapeutic drugs at a tumor site is achieved, the treatment complexity caused by biological distribution of different pharmacokinetics in combined administration is avoided, and the problems of multi-drug delivery and safe and effective release in anti-tumor treatment are solved.

column12: MRNA (messenger ribonucleic acid) lipid nanoparticle delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an mRNA (messenger Ribonucleic Acid) lipid nanoparticle delivery system as well as a preparation method and application thereof. A delivery system for mRNA drugs is a lipid nanoparticle loaded with one or more mRNAs. The lipid nanoparticles are prepared from the following raw materials: ionizable cationic lipid DHA-1, cholesterol and a phospholipid polyethylene glycol derivative DMG-PEG 2000. The lipid is simple in component, only comprises three components, does not need auxiliary phospholipids, and is lower in cost, simpler and more convenient in process and suitable for large-scale production. According to the invention, DHA1 cationic lipid is adopted as a main component of a nucleic acid delivery dosage form for the first time for patent application, and raw materials are not limited by patent barriers. Animal experiments prove that the actual effect of the delivery system reaches the effect of a nucleic acid delivery system adopted by the latest international listed products, and the delivery system has commercial production value.

column12: Nanocage formed based on adriamycin-cyclodextrin multiple acting forces and preparation thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nanocage formed based on doxorubicin-cyclodextrin multiple acting force and preparation of the nanocage. A preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a tumor microenvironment response cyclodextrin supramolecule (PCD) synthesized by beta-cyclodextrin (beta-CD) and a cross-linking agent containing a disulfide bond; (2) combining the PCD with doxorubicin (DOX) through host-guest acting force and chemical crosslinking effect between macromolecules and micromolecules to obtain PDOX; and (3) introducing PEG-NH2 into the PDOX to obtain a nano-sized supramolecular nanocage, and naming the product as PDOP. The obtained cyclodextrin nanocage can form supramolecular drug micelles in water, has the advantages of high micelle stability, controllable micelle shape, high drug loading capacity, low toxic and side effects, good drug controlled release and the like, responds to release based on a tumor microenvironment, and has a wide application prospect in the aspect of constructing a long-circulation deep-penetration intelligent drug delivery system.

column12: STABLE COLLOIDAL DRUG AGGREGATES AND METHODS OF MANUFACTURE AND USE THEREOF
column13: The present application provides a colloid drug aggregate composition and methods of use and manufacture thereof. While the formation of colloidal aggregates leads to artifacts in early drug discovery, their composition makes them attractive as nanoparticle formulations for targeted drug delivery. The present application provides an acid-responsive composition comprising: a colloidal aggregate of one or more drugs and a stabilizing agent, wherein the colloidal aggregate disrupts, dissolves or disassembles when the acid-responsive composition is in an acid environment having a pH of less than 7.4. The colloidal aggregate of the composition will disassemble upon contact with acid or upon introduction to an acidic environment, such as is found in the endosomes of cells. This approach makes this composition an attractive vehicle for drug delivery to a target site in a subject or to cells.

column12: CANNABINOID NANOMICELLE PREPARATION AND METHOD FOR PREPARING SAME
column13: The invention discloses a cannabinoid nano-micelle preparation and a preparation method thereof. column13: Anesthetics covalently conjugated onto biodegradable and biocompatible hydrophilic polymers via hydrolysable linkages provide controlled release of local anesthetics in vivo in an effective amount for nerve blockade with reduced toxicity relative to the unconjugated anesthetic agent. Exemplary formulations of Poly (glycerol sebacate) (PGS), optionally including Poly ethylene glycol (PEG) polymers conjugated to Tetrodotoxin (TTX) (PGS-PEG-TTX and PGS-TTX), and methods of use thereof are provided Nerve blockade from PGS-PEG-TTX and PGS-TTX was associated with minimal systemic and local toxicity to the muscle and the peripheral nerves. TDP-TTX conjugates homogeneously dispersed into PEG200 are also described. PEG200 not only worked as a medium, but also worked as a chemical permeation enhancer (CPE) to enhance the effectiveness of TTX.

According to the invention, the method comprises the following steps: preparing the polymeric nano systems as reticulated structure, starting from acrylic acid-modified fibroin of natural silk (SF-Ac) and tetraethylene glycol diacrylate (PEG), loading the polymeric nano systems with 5FU, loading the nano systems with DNA synthetic labels, obtaining cell cultures of colorectal adenocarcinoma belonging to the cell line HT-29 as in-vitro cell model of colorectal cancer, applying the treatments, followed by validation of nano system internalization by flow cytometry, detection and quantification of DNA synthetic labels internalized in tumor cells HT-29 using the qRT-PCR technique, i.e. determining the quantity of 5FU internalized in target cells by means of polymeric nano systems, using an available computing algorithm, so that the model can provide an accurate control of the nano system administration dose and therapy effectiveness.

column12: ORAL ADMINISTRATION OF UNSTABLE OR POORLY-ABSORBED DRUGS
column13: The disclosure relates to a dosage forms and combinations of dosage forms useful for effective oral administration of drugs which are otherwise unsuitable for oral administration, owing to acid- and/or protease-mediated degradation. The dosage forms include a self-microemulsifying drug delivery system (SMEDDS) with which the drug is combined and an antacid. When co-administered to a mammal, the dosage form(s) can prevent drug degradation by the strong acid and digestive enzymes normally present in the gastric environment, and can improve water-soluble drug absorption in gastrointestinal (GI) tract. The dosage forms can be used to effectively administer insulin by an oral route, for example, such as in the form of a powder that can be stored for long periods and reconstituted with water or another fluid shortly before administration.

column12: SOLUTE CARRIER FAMILY 46 MEMBER 3 (SLC46A3) AS MARKER FOR LIPID-BASED NANOPARTICLE CANCER THERAPY AND DIAGNOSTICS
column13: SLC46A3 has been identified as a lipid-based nanoparticle-specific biomarker predictive of nanoparticle -cancer cell affinity. SLC46A3 has a strong inverse association with lipid-based nanoparticle uptake across multiple nanoparticle formulations. Tissues with decreased expression levels of SLC46A3 have a greater uptake of lipid-based nanoparticles. The inverse relationship of SLC46A3 expression in tumor tissue and affinity for lipid-based nanoparticles has therapeutic and diagnostic implications, including cancer therapy and diagnosis, and identification of patients most likely to benefit from a lipid-based nanotherapeutic for improved stratification in clinical trials.

column12: PH-responsive siRNA delivery system
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a pH responsive siRNA delivery system for a tumor growth factor receptor. The delivery system provided by the invention comprises a molecule formed by a positive-sense strand ssRNA modified by a polypeptide derivative and an antisense strand asRNA modified by a PEG derivative, polypeptide in the delivery system is c (RGDfK), PEG derivative modified antisense strand asRNA is formed by connecting and reacting methoxy polyethylene glycol propionaldehyde (mPEG-CHO) molecules, coupling molecules and asRNA, the PEG molecular weight in the mPEG-CHO is 500-20000, hydrazone bonds are formed between the mPEG-CHO and the coupling molecules, the coupling molecules comprise 8-amino-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, 5-dimethoxy-3, the organic solvent is one or more of 2, 6-dioxaoctanoic acid, 4-(benzyl amino) benzoyl hydrazine, N-maleyl-beta-alanine and 3-maleimidopropionic acid. column12: Preparation method of phycocyanin molecularly imprinted drug carrier taking ZIF-8 as matrix
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a phycocyanin molecularly imprinted drug carrier taking ZIF-8 as a matrix, and belongs to the field of functional material preparation. The invention aims to solve the problems of poor drug synergistic effect, low drug loading rate, easy leakage of drugs in advance, limited targeting and large toxic and side effects of the existing drug carrier. According to the method, adriamycin is packaged in ZIF-8 to serve as a carrier matrix, surface imprinting polymerization is adopted, phycocyanin serves as a template molecule, and the drug-loaded imprinted polymer is prepared without eluting the template molecule. On the basis, a PEG sequence connected with folic acid is modified, and calcium carbonate is doped, so that the targeted drug-loaded molecularly imprinted polymer is prepared. The drug carrier disclosed by the invention has excellent drug loading ratio, good drug release effect and biodegradability, and can target cancer cells for dual-drug synergistic treatment. The system can be used as a drug delivery system of a compound preparation.

column12: Preparation and application of phenylboronic acid/folic acid dual-targeting nano delivery carrier
column13: The invention relates to a nano delivery carrier which is prepared by taking dendritic polylysine (DGL), phenylboronic acid-polyethylene glycol (PBA-PEG-COOH) and folic acid-polyethylene glycol (FA-PEG-COOH) as main raw materials and has a sialic acid and folic acid receptor dual targeting function as well as a preparation method and application of the nano delivery carrier. The activated PBA-PEG-COOH is added into a DGL solution, then the activated FA-PEG-COOH is added, stirring reaction, dialysis and freeze drying are performed, and the dual-targeting nano delivery carrier PBA/FA-PEG-DGL with the surface modified by phenylboronic acid and folic acid targeting ligands is obtained. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a tumor chemotherapeutic drug into an aqueous solution of PBA/FA-PEG-DGL by a physical embedding method, stirring in a dark place, dialyzing, and freeze-drying to obtain a final product. The small molecular targeting ligand is cheap and easy to obtain, high in stability and simple in preparation method, and the cost of the material is reduced. The drug delivery system is suitable for delivery of various tumor chemotherapeutic drugs, realizes efficient anti-tumor efficacy, reduces toxic and side effects, provides a new idea for clinical treatment of tumors, and brings new hope.

column12: Bioerodible cross-linked hydrogel implants and related methods of use
column13: The present disclosure is directed to a composite implant for the sustained release of a therapeutic agent from a hydrogel matrix. The hydrogel matrix may be a cross-linked bioerodible polyethylene glycol (PEG) hydrogel with a therapeutic complex dispersed within the cross-linked bioerodible PEG hydrogel. The therapeutic complex may include a therapeutic agent in association with mesoporous silica particles. The composite implant is configured to be delivered to or implanted into an eye of a subject or patient. The composite implant may be used treat ocular disease in a subject or patient. Ocular diseases may be selected from at least one of neovascular age related macular degeneration (AMD), diabetic macular edema, or macular edema following retinal vein occlusion.
